**Fact.** Aerobic respiration: C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ → 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + ~30–32 ATP (net) per glucose.

**Fact.** Stages: glycolysis (cytoplasm, 2 ATP + 2 NADH), pyruvate oxidation → acetyl-CoA, Krebs cycle (matrix, 2 GTP + 6 NADH + 2 FADH₂ per glucose), oxidative phosphorylation (inner membrane, electron transport + chemiosmosis).
**Fact.** Anaerobic respiration/fermentation regenerates NAD⁺ with only 2 ATP net (lactic acid or ethanol + CO₂).
